blocks.text: BULAKAN, Bulacan—For a second time, youth groups and local folks at a coastal village in the Bulacan town of Bulakan turned their river into a colorful playground reliving their childhood memories of sailing their ‘bangkang papel’ (paper boats). This happened in this year’s ‘Bangkaripas, Karera ng mga Bangkang Kumakaripas’ at the start of the week, October 19. Bangkaripas began in 2024 as a miniature boats race. Last week, 13 motor-operated bright and dashing small boats raced down the river of Barangay Tibig, operated by young boys and adults.
